title: Fast and accurate neural triage decoding of ultra-high-rate quantum LDPC codes
abstract: arXiv:2610.40490v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum error correction is essential for fault-tolerant quantum computing. High-rate quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes have emerged as a promising approach to reducing the substantial physical qubit overhead of quantum error correction, enabling encoding rates exceeding $1/2$ in blocks of approximately one thousand physical data qubits. However, their practical implementation requires decoders that combine high accuracy with low latency to keep pace with quantum hardware. Existing decoders of high-rate qLDPC codes can achieve high accuracy but often incur substantial computational latency, whereas neural network decoders have yet to be demonstrated for high-rate qLDPC codes. Here, we introduce \emph{neural triage decoding}, a framework that uses syndrome consistency to adaptively allocate neural computation. translated_title: 超高速率量子LDPC码的快速精准神经分诊译码
translated_abstract: 量子纠错对于容错量子计算至关重要。高速率量子低密度奇偶校验码已成为降低量子纠错中巨大物理量子比特开销的一种有前景的方法，能够在大约一千个物理数据量子比特的码块中实现超过1/2的编码率。然而，其实际应用需要兼具高精度和低延迟的译码器，以跟上量子硬件的运行速度。现有的高速率qLDPC码译码器虽然可以达到高精度，但往往带来较大的计算延迟，而神经网络译码器尚未在高速率qLDPC码上得到验证。在此，我们提出了“神经分诊译码”框架，该框架利用综合征一致性来自适应地分配神经计算。局部神经消息传递网络快速预测错误校正，额外的迭代用于消除残余综合征……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“神经分诊译码”框架，利用综合征一致性自适应分配神经网络的计算量，首次实现了超高速率量子LDPC码的快速且高精度译码，为容错量子计算提供了低延迟的实用译码方案。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces neural triage decoding, a framework that adaptively allocates neural computation based on syndrome consistency, achieving fast and accurate decoding of ultra-high-rate quantum LDPC codes for fault-tolerant quantum computing.
